section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the methodology for measuring actual-ideal weight discrepancy using the Photographic Figure Rating Scale (PFRS), a figural rating scale with 10 photographic images of women varying in BMI. The study was conducted with Brazilian university women, who rated figures representing their current and ideal body sizes, with discrepancy computed as the absolute difference between these ratings.
